name: caniuse
description: caniuse.com: browser support tables for web platform features (HTML, CSS, JS APIs). The CLI searches features, fetches per-browser support data, compares browser versions, reads the feature index, news, usage share and feature-suggestion list.

commands.name: search-features
commands.summary: Search caniuse features by keyword; returns matching feature IDs (caniuse, wf-* web-features and mdn-* BCD IDs)

commands.name: get-feature-support
commands.summary: Get full support data (title, description, spec, baseline status, per-browser per-version support stats) for one or more feature IDs

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated feature IDs as returned by search-features, e.g. 'css-grid' or 'flexbox,flexbox-gap,wf-aspect-ratio'

commands.name: compare-browsers
commands.summary: Compare feature support between browser versions; returns the raw comparison result (IDs of features whose support differs between the given versions)

params.name: compare
params.description: Comma-separated list of '<browser> <version>' pairs, e.g. 'chrome 120,firefox 120,safari 17'. Browser keys: chrome, firefox, safari, edge, opera, ios_saf, ie, etc. Versions must exist in caniuse data

params.name: cats
params.description: Comma-separated feature categories to include (CSS, HTML5, JS, JS API, Other, Security, SVG)

commands.name: get-feature-page
commands.summary: Get a feature's detail page summary: title, spec link and status, description and global usage percentages (works for caniuse IDs, wf-* and mdn-* IDs)
commands.source: E9 E10 E17 E18 GET https://caniuse.com/css-grid

commands.name: list-features-index
commands.summary: List all features in the caniuse index (titles and links, grouped by category in page order: CSS, HTML5, ...); the feature ID is the last path segment of href (e.g. 'css-rrggbbaa')

commands.name: list-news
commands.summary: List latest caniuse news / newly added features

commands.name: get-usage-table
commands.summary: Get the browser usage-share table: per browser, the versions with their global usage percentage

commands.name: list-feature-suggestions
commands.summary: List the top suggested features not yet on caniuse, ranked by GitHub votes

notes: Typical flow: search-features or compare-browsers returns feature IDs; pass them (comma-separated) to get-feature-support for full data, or to get-feature-page for global usage percentages.

Support stat codes in get-feature-support: y = supported, a = partial, n = not supported, p = polyfill available, u = unknown, x = needs a prefix, d = disabled by default; '#N' refers to note number N.
The stats object is large (every version of every browser). Request few IDs at a time.
list-feature-suggestions 'row' is the full row text, '<rank>. <title><votes>'. The trailing digits are the vote count. The first row is the table header.
In get-usage-table, versions_usage is the concatenated text '<version>:<pct>%' for each version of that browser.

The /ciu/filter page (category/baseline filters with group and sort) is rendered client-side and has no separate data endpoint, so it is not exposed. Use list-features-index plus get-feature-support (baseline_status) instead.
There is no pagination. Raw data is also published at github.com/Fyrd/caniuse. No login is needed.
